item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 12/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure is expected to edge closer to the coast of southern China gradually today, and bring showers and thunderstorms to the region. An easterly airstream will reach the coast of Guangdong on Monday. It will be windier over the region in the following few days. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be a few showers over southern China in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 12/05 (Sunday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Sunny intervals and relatively low visibility in some areas during the day. More showers with a few thunderstorms later.
